objective: Improve legitimate Android AdMob impressions in public, Organization and Cluster Walls plus new Home, Profile, Connect inbox and Cluster dashboards; use stable banner/native sponsored media frames without shifting the content layout or touching chat/call flows.
productionBaselineEvidence: Reconciled against 2026-11-01 main efb5a180d5b6422daa077574be6ce1f0bd705248; Bible/KL merges have no overlapping files. 2026-11-01 PH production AdMob app-side diagnostics: 35 requests over 9 Android sessions and 3 impression callbacks; public_wall_entry had 16 request events and 10 no-fill errors. Main commit 54dae504382381173709e2be1883803b9a8abb3b. Native video creative requires configured AdMob Native unit with video enabled. No live uplift demonstrated.
chosenApproach: Keep BannerAd SDK mounted when no-fill so configured auto refresh can work without manual loops. Reserve 68px first-view banner area and 352px native inline media frame. Replace potentially unbounded InteractionManager initialization delay with a first-paint 600ms bootstrap. Increase Android-only native row opportunity cadence to first 5 then 6-9 posts, while honoring production environment overrides. Add an inventory-aware native media sponsored card shared with non-chat Home, Profile, Connect inbox and scoped Cluster/Organization dashboards, plus independent viewport-first banners. Reuse existing banner and Native ad IDs and secure route/consent guards; scope-switch gets distinct stable slotId. Android-only wrapper makes non-Wall sponsored video/image cards a no-op on web; generic component has a compatible optional surface type. If no AdMob Native unit is configured, new non-Wall media slots request a genuine 300x250 medium-rectangle video-capable Banner creative through already-existing banner units; Wall fallback stays small.
selectionRationale: Corrects visibility and layout stability faults without creating artificial impressions, changing other screens, or issuing aggressive requests that lower fill rate. Connect ads belong to list header/footer, never active thread, voice/video calls, or typing surfaces. Native ad creative is provider controlled, including video.
alternativeApproaches: Ad request on every post or every tap: rejected because of policy, inventory and performance risks.
Manually replay user videos as fake sponsored creative: rejected; only authentic NativeAd creative and SDK media are allowed.
Reserve predictable ad dimensions and modestly increase legitimate visible native ad opportunities: selected.
